chapter: Clarinet teachers and the Baton Rouge scene
title: Isadore Fritz named as second teacher
summary: Joe names Isadore Fritz as his other teacher, whom Barry notes George Lewis idolized.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the first horn: clarinet and saxophone beginnings

blocks.x: Let me ask you this before we forget it. Manuel Roque... You said there was a couple of guys who taught you. Who was the other guy?
I had another guy named Isadore Fritz(?). They were good...
I was going to ask you about Isadore Fritz(?) later on. I ought to make a note of it right now.

I don't want to get into that now, but I wanted to talk about Isadore Fritz(?) later. He's one of the guys who George Lewis said was a big idol of his. But getting back to Manuel Roque, what kind of music did he play? Or did he teach for a living?
